newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks buoyant, semiconductors on fire.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks buoyant, semiconductors on fire.

text.p: U.S. blue chips moved higher in late trading as strength in technology shares fueled a rally that carried the Dow and Nasdaq to new high territory.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was up 40 to 7386. Earlier, a wave of buying moved the index as high as 7394, but it fizzled a bit as it neared the next century marker at 7400.
Strength in International Business Machines Corp, up 4-1/8 to 177-1/2, boosted the 30-stock average. Other strong Dow components were DuPont Co and Boeing.
A surge in semiconductors led the Nasdaq Composite higher. The index broke through 1,400 and rose 16 to 1406.

The Philadelphia Stock Exchange's Semiconductor Index, which consists of 16 chip and semiconductor equipment makers, rose 10 to 330, nearly double its value in July when the index was as low as about 164.
Micron Technology Inc rose 4-1/4 to 42-1/2. Advanced Micro Devices Inc was up 1-1/4 to 42-1/4 and Intel jumped 5-7/16 to 168-5/8.
Breadth on the New York Stock Exchange was negative with decliners outnumbering advancers 13 to 11.
